warnings: Complex factorial design with 2 factors (coastal sediment x seaweed extract) across 3 varieties - need to extract seaweed extract effect vs control for each variety
Coastal sediment is NOT a biostimulant - only extract seaweed extract treatments
Treatment codes are confusing: S0=no seaweed, S1=3% seaweed, C0=no coastal sediment, C1=40t/ha coastal sediment
Must extract S1C0 vs S0C0 AND S1C1 vs S0C1 for each variety to get seaweed extract effect
Yield data in Table 4 shows statistical significance letters but no variance measures provided
Different varieties may respond differently - each variety comparison should be extracted separately
WARNING: VAR-UNCLEAR - Variance type not clearly stated
recon.variance_source: Table 4 shows 'The mean value in one column followed by the same letter showed no significant difference at p < 0.05' but no SE, SD, or LSD values provided
recon.control_definition: S0 = no foliar seaweed extract application (control)
recon.treatment_definition: S1 = foliar seaweed extract at 3% concentration applied three times at 15-day intervals starting 30 days after transplanting
recon.potential_tc_confusion: Risk of including coastal sediment as biostimulant - it's an ameliorant, not a biostimulant. Only seaweed extract is the biostimulant intervention
recon.sample_size_source: Randomized Complete Block Design (RCBD) with 'three factors' and 'divided into 60 experimental plots' suggests 3 replications per treatment combination (2×2×3×3=36 treatment combinations)
recon.factorial_structure: ["foliar seaweed extract (2 levels)", "coastal sediment (2 levels)", "variety (3 levels)"]
recon.extraction_guidance: Extract yield data from Table 4. For each variety (V1=Bima, V2=Moujung, V3=Sumenep), extract two comparisons: (1) S1C0V vs S0C0V (seaweed effect without coastal sediment) and (2) S1C1V vs S0C1V (seaweed effect with coastal sediment). This gives 6 total comparisons. No variance data available - mark as unavailable. Focus only on seaweed extract as biostimulant intervention, ignore coastal sediment treatments.
